'''Warrant Officer''' was a rank present in many militaries across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A warrant officer did not have a specific task as other ranks such as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] did, but instead specialized in a particular field that other crew members had little or no knowledge of. An example of this would be a warrant officer who specialized in monitoring the ship's functions, or a warrant officer who specialized in operating the ship's tractor beam.

In some militaries, the next rank after Warrant Officer was [[Chief Warrant Officer]], which was ascended by [[Master Warrant Officer]] (typically the highest noncommissioned officer rank in a given military). In other militaries (such as the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and subsequently the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]), there were two Warrant Officer ranks: [[Junior Warrant Officer]] and [[Senior Warrant Officer]]

==Behind the scenes==
The ranks Chief Warrant Officer (CWO) and Master Warrant Officer (MWO) from the Canadian Military Forces and Singapore Armed Forces, where CWO outranks MWO. However, in [[Galaxy at War]] it is stated that MWO typically outranks CWO (and that MWO is generally the highest noncommissioned officer rank in a military).

Additionally, Warrant Officers are generally noncommissioned, enlisted officers, in real life and in ''Star Wars''. [[Galaxy at War]] supports this as well (see above). Yet the Junior Warrant Officer and Senior Warrant Officer ranks are listed elsewhere in [[Galaxy at War]] as being the first commissioned officer ranks in both the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. This may be in accord with how Warrant Officers are considered to be a form of commissioned officer in the United States military, unlike most other real world militaries.
